items.summary: Published the first source-pinned shortlist: visual direction, UI review, and React or Next.js performance, with explicit limits and no performance ranking.
Added source-pinned React skills for component architecture and meaningful interface motion; surfaced a reported Composition Patterns example issue without calling it pool verification.
Added an adoption gate after task fit: target agent, project or global scope, source revision, local edits, and upstream-update review. Rechecked the existing Anthropic and Vercel source pins.

Added OpenAI Frontend App Builder as a conditional sixth task lane for new visual surfaces that can use an Image Gen concept, approval, browser verification, and image comparison. Rechecked the existing Anthropic and Vercel source pins.

Added OpenAI Product Design Audit as a conditional seventh task lane for a real product flow that can be captured and inspected. Separated rendered-flow audit from source-file UI review and named the screenshot evidence limit.
Added Vercel Agent Browser 0.38.1 as a conditional eighth task lane for navigating and retaining runnable UI states. Separated capture evidence from a design or accessibility verdict.

Added Vercel Agent Browser Dogfood 0.38.1 as a conditional ninth task lane for exploratory QA of a reachable frontend with replayable browser evidence. Separated a reproducible bug report from source review, system consistency, design direction, and a quality verdict.

Added OpenAI Frontend Testing & Debugging as a conditional tenth task lane for a named rendered frontend change or bug flow. Added a proof-surface rule: browser backend, viewport, target URL, session context, and visible state belong with capture evidence; the current skill source is mutable rather than source-pinned.

Added PracticalSwan Frontend Design 2.0 as a source-pinned conditional listing for substantial product work that needs explicit system context, relevant states, responsive checks, and rendered verification. The declared workflow remains untested; readers should trial one primary design-direction skill rather than stack overlapping instructions by default.

Added Wenkang Frontend Design as a source-pinned conditional listing for human visual decisions on a known route or defined concept before implementation. Its local preview can export choices and annotations back to Codex, but it is not proof that the live route matches or works.

Held Snowe UI Skill outside the catalogue after GitHub displayed a YAML error in its current SKILL.md frontmatter. The pool did not install it or test host behavior. The adoption guidance now checks package readiness before workflow fit.

Added OpenAI Product Design Ideate as a conditional thirteenth listing for choosing among three image-based visual directions before prototype work. Its source is mutable, and its plugin availability and outcomes are untested by the pool.

Added PaulRBerg Frontend Design as a conditional mutable-source listing for an existing or substantial screen that needs one project-bound direction, local-system fidelity, and rendered inspection. Its Codex loading, browser dependency, and results are untested by the pool.

Added OpenAI Game UI Frontend as a conditional mutable-source listing for browser-game HUDs, menus, and overlays that need to protect the playfield and make camera or menu input boundaries explicit. Its Codex loading and outcomes are untested by the pool.
Added Hueyexe Forms, Inputs, and Checkout as a conditional mutable-source listing for form field necessity, validation, errors, and submission recovery. Codex loading and results are untested.

Verified the pinned React Composition Patterns lifted-state example mismatch against its related rule and current main. The listing now gives a direct source-level warning without claiming a runtime failure.

Held OpenDesign frontend-skill outside the catalogue because its current entry is a discovery pointer to an OpenAI curated skill removed from the live upstream collection; no installation or result was tested.
Clarified Anthropic Frontend Design task fit: new visual direction versus an existing token and component system. Corrected its source pin link; no result was tested.
Added two benchmark checks and a no-skill comparison route. Different task and loading setups prevent either study from ranking our listings or visual quality.

Separated a source-derived design-system skill pipeline from the sixteen ready-made listings and gave existing-system teams a brief-first decision path. The pipeline and outcomes remain untested by this pool.
Held Silk Design outside the sixteen listings. Its motion-first instructions make global scrolling and reveals defaults; reduced-motion and mobile results need a bounded test.
Added a post-update file check for locally adapted skills. Inspected Vercel Skills global-update source and two user reports; no local CLI reproduction.
Added a first-screen dashboard decision: start with project context when an existing design system governs the screen; trial one conditional skill only for a named gap. No outcome test.
Added a one-skill, no-install trial route and full-prompt check. A version-specific pipe truncation is a user report, not a pool reproduction.
Corrected the Anthropic Frontend Design fit note: its pinned instructions say a fixed brief wins over palette and type defaults. No result test or new listing.
Clarified Product Design Ideate’s Get Context brief gate and separated visual direction from small in-app corrections. No new listing or outcome test.
Separated Anthropic Web Artifacts Builder’s single-file Claude artifact workflow from live-site visual correction. No new listing or outcome test.
Separated visual concept work from targeted frontend QA and added a project-specific release-check gate. Two skill files inspected; no outcome test.
Clarified that Agent Browser v0.38.1 SKILL.md is a discovery stub and linked the full tagged core source. No installation or outcome test.
Clarified that Game UI Frontend targets browser-game HUDs and responsive browser layouts, not native mobile apps; added a platform gate and a concrete comparison plan without claiming a result.
Separated OpenDesign’s stale OpenAI frontend-skill pointer from its distinct, substantive Anthropic frontend-design adaptation; no new catalogue listing or result test.
Published a source-limited watch note on Figment as a code-to-Figma handoff route; no new web-implementation recommendation.
Added a model-specific trial warning from a functional web-skill benchmark. No new listing or visual outcome claim.
Added a limited contributor result on pill-shaped buttons with Frontend Design and a concrete rendered-result check; no skill-versus-no-skill effect or new listing claimed.
Added a two-check comparison method for visual-system fit and working behavior; VISTA studied agents, not these skill listings, and no pool-run trial is claimed.
Added a bounded reading of a contributor-reported Frontend Design revision test: 21 of 28 decisive screenshot comparisons, without a no-skill baseline or current-source result.
Added a Claude Code invocation check before skill outcome comparisons; installation alone does not show that the full skill instructions loaded.
Added the documented Claude Code /skill-doctor usage check with version and session limits; separated prior invocation from frontend outcome and kept a no-skill baseline.
